entries.source: Deals lightning damage and drains resources.
entries.target: 造成闪电伤害，削减敌人的资源。

entries.source: shock your foe dealing %d damage and draining some of their resources
entries.target: 电击你的敌人，造成 %d 点伤害，并削减其部分资源。

entries.source: deal lightning damage to the target based on cunning with a 25% chance to daze, and arc to up to 3 targets.
entries.target: 对目标造成基于灵巧的闪电伤害，并有25%几率使其眩晕，闪电最多在3个目标间跳跃。

entries.source: Using small steam engines and the miracles of the latest automation discoveries you are able to create Steam Powered Armour. A full plate armour that helps your movement and has intrinsic protection mechanisms.
entries.target: 使用小型蒸汽机和你最新发现的自动化技术，你可以制造蒸汽动力装甲。这个板甲增强你的行动能力并提供强大的防护能力。

entries.source: #GOLD#Your steam-powered boots, helm and gauntlets automatically connect to your steam-powered armour, enabling new functions.
entries.target: #GOLD#你的蒸汽动力靴、头盔和手套自动连接到你的蒸汽动力装甲，获得新的功能。

entries.source: #GOLD#Your steam-powered armor disconnects from the other pieces.
entries.target: #GOLD#你的蒸汽动力装甲与其他组件断线了。

entries.source: Deals high light damage and increases critical multiplier.
entries.target: 造成大量光系伤害，增加暴击系数。

entries.source: flashes light on your target dealing %d damage
entries.target: 闪光攻击敌人，造成%d伤害。

entries.source: From your hands have been wrought incredible works. Your works have been forged in fire, and so have you.
entries.target: 你的双手曾造就无数非凡作品。你的作品在烈火中锻造，你亦如此。

entries.source: On landing any melee attack, release a fiery shockwave, dealing fire and physical damage each equal to your steampower in a cone from the target of radius 3.
entries.target: 每次近战攻击命中时，都会释放一道火焰冲击波，以目标为起点对半径 3 的锥形范围造成火焰伤害和物理伤害，二者各等于你的蒸汽强度。

entries.source: let you fight up to -%%d life and reduces all damage by %d%%%% for %d turns (takes no time to activate)
entries.target: 让你能继续战斗直到-%%d生命值，同时获得%d%%%%全体伤害抗性。效果持续%d回合，使用不消耗时间。

entries.source: remove %d physical effects and grants a frost aura (%s cold, darkness and nature affinity)
entries.target: 清除%d项物理负面效果并制造寒霜光环，获得%s寒冷、暗影和自然伤害亲和。

entries.source: remove %d magical effects and grants a fiery aura (%s fire, light and lightning affinity)
entries.target: 清除%d项魔法负面效果并制造烈火光环，获得%s火焰、光系和闪电伤害亲和。

entries.source: remove %d mental effects and grants a water aura (%s blight, mind and acid affinity).
entries.target: 清除%d项精神负面效果并制造静水光环，获得%s枯萎、精神和酸性伤害亲和。

entries.source: increases all saves by %d and healing factor by half
entries.target: 增加全豁免%d点，增加一半治疗系数
